svg.aria-label: Anthropic: console.anthropic.com (https://console.anthropic.com). One full debate costs about $0.10-0.20 on Sonnet 4.6 with tools, about $0.05 without. LangSmith: smith.langchain.com (https://smith.langchain.com). Free tier: 5k traces per month. Langfuse: cloud.langfuse.com (https://cloud.langfuse.com) (EU) or us.cloud.langfuse.com (https://us.cloud.langfuse.com) (US). Free tier: 50k observations per month. Tavily: tavily.com (https://tavily.com). Free tier: 1,000 credits per month, one credit per basic search or extract. One debate budgets at most 24 calls, so 40+ debates fit
